Snapshot before group, disowned current candidate with active parent reraces real parent; checkpoint raises internal reopen before native rerace. Native sets reopened then enqueues. Filter valid and active; empty skips.

Prefer subset excluding Blue E-parent with unaccepted later Red S source and decision<parent stop; if empty retain eligible. Red S preference does not independently test E41.
